items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The first session, 'Inglewood,' probably at Van Gelder Studios, July 1965, Charles, Jackie, Bobby, Larry and yourself. You recorded two tracks...

ctx.x: There was "Jackknife" and there was another one, two records with him. One with Larry Willis and…
Yes, right. The other session with Bobby.
Bobby Hutcherson was on that session?
